final: WITH member_sums AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS amount_sum FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT amount_sum, 1.0 * amount_sum / SUM(amount_sum) OVER () AS share FROM member_sums), stats AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(shares.amount_sum), AVG(shares.share), AVG(shares.share - stats.avg_share) FROM shares CROSS JOIN stats WHERE shares.share > stats.avg_share
